About Exploration

Natsuno and the others explore ruins and other places in order to survive.
Look for useful items and food.
Natsuno and the others explore according to their own will， but you can also support them by entering text.

About Text Input

You can enter text in the text input field below the text window and communicate it to Natsuno and the others.
During scenario events， you can enter text only while the pencil icon is displayed in the text window.

About Words in Red

Words may sometimes appear in red in the text.
Clicking one of these words will copy it to the text input field (some words cannot be copied).
If you have a companion， right-clicking a word will copy it to the other character's text input field.

About Health/Hunger

Health decreases through combat with enemies and other situations. When health reaches zero， you get a Game Over and lose all inventory except equipped items.
Hunger decreases with every action during exploration. If hunger reaches zero during an exploration， the exploration will end automatically.
Both health and hunger are fully restored when exploration ends.

About Inventory During Exploration

During exploration， you can check items and food you have obtained by pressing the “Inventory” button.
You can check an item's details， and give it to a companion if you have one.
There is an inventory limit， so if you exceed it， you must discard items.

About “Traits”

Each character has their own Traits.
You can check the effects of each Trait during exploration by pressing the “Traits” button.

About the “Story” Screen

The “Story” screen lets you check the scenario outline.
Once you meet an episode's progression requirements through exploration， you can continue the story from the “Story” screen.

About the “Explorer” Screen

On the “Explorer” screen， you can select the data to play and head out on an exploration.
During exploration， you can gather items and food.

About the “Inventory” Screen

On the “Inventory” screen， you can store items obtained through exploration and other activities in the Storage Shelf.
You can also select Crafting from the categories to create items and dishes.
You can quickly store an item in your inventory by right-clicking it.

About Save Data

This game supports auto save. Your progress is automatically saved when advancing the scenario， finishing an exploration， and at other points.
To delete save data， open Options from the title screen and select “Delete Save Data.”

About Early Access

This is an Early Access version.
Some system features， scenario content， resources， and other elements differ from the full version.
Future updates are planned to improve the exploration-focused systems and add episodes， characters， and more.

Feedback， Impressions & Bug Reports

We welcome your feedback and impressions to help us provide a better experience.
If you encounter behavior that appears to be a bug， we would also appreciate your report.
For details， please visit the official website (https://natsuno-kanata.online/).
